```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
features <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(project_folder, features_file))
```

# Configured host genomes

Each configured host genome is sequentially decontaminated against in the
`preprocess` module, in the order listed here.

```{r hosts-table}
hosts <- features$hosts
if (is.null(hosts) || length(hosts) == 0) {
  cat("_No host genomes configured -- this is an environmental-sample run with no decontamination step._\n")
} else {
  host_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "reference", "hosts")
  host_df <- tibble::tibble(
    order = seq_along(hosts),
    host = names(hosts),
    configured_path = unlist(hosts),
    recompressed_size_mb = purrr::map_dbl(names(hosts), function(h) {
      p <- file.path(host_dir, paste0(h, ".fa.gz"))
      if (file.exists(p)) round(file.size(p) / 1024^2, 1) else NA
    })
  )
  preview_table(host_df, n = nrow(host_df), caption = "Configured hosts, in decontamination order")
}
```

# Runtime statistics

bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "reference")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "reference module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
